definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize that something is genuine or to express sincere feelings.
Used to confirm or agree with something strongly.

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}に⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本当|ほんとう}に⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本当|ほんとう}に⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: He is really good at Japanese — the first time I heard him speak, I thought he was Japanese.

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}に⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
「⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。」「{本当|ほんとう}に。」
examples.english: "It's hot today, isn't it?" "It sure is."

examples.japanese: {本当|ほんとう}に⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。⟦お{疲|つか}れさまでした→お疲れ様：05208_otsukaresama⟧。
examples.english: That was really tough, wasn't it. Good work.

notes:
{本当|ほんとう}に is the adverbial form of ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧ (truth/reality), used to emphasize sincerity or degree.

CASUAL FORMS:
- ⟦ほんとに→ほんと：08758_honto⟧: common casual contraction
- ⟦ほんと→ほんと：08758_honto⟧: very casual, often sentence-final
- ⟦マジで→まじで：09319_majide⟧: slang equivalent (from ⟦{本気|まじ}→本気：03153_honki⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本当|ほんとう}に⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧: thank you so much
- {本当|ほんとう}に⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧: I'm really sorry
- {本当|ほんとう}に⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧: really delicious

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{確|たし}かに→確かに：04717_tashikani⟧: certainly, indeed (confirming facts)
- ⟦{実|じつ}に→実に：03820_jitsuni⟧: truly, indeed (more formal/literary)
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very (degree only, not sincerity)

USAGE:
{本当|ほんとう}に emphasizes both degree (really good) and genuineness (truly/sincerely), while ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ only emphasizes degree.
